case_study: Two ZK implementations of swiyu.shared.age25-holder-challenge.v0 run the same selected Swiyu OID4VP flow. Hidden birth dates differ; declared public meaning does not. Implementation identity may differ.
novelty: Differential leakage over complete selected OID4VP transcripts across two circuits that share one pinned claim, not only A/B credentials on a single backend.
qualification: Same pinned claim through two Swiyu OID4VP integrations (EPFL d10 and OpenAC age-25). Selected application HTTP: management create, request object, direct_post, management result. Fixture-only mock HTTP verifier and opaque proof envelope. Never used as cryptographic evidence. Semantically equivalent public_context must alpha-normalize the dynamic response_uri request UUID (path segment) as well as session nonce/state. Raw events retain the UUID. Request JWT signatures are treated as length-only when mapping.signature_opaque is set.
